title: GET /api/tasks randomly returns an empty list
summary: The GET handler returns [] about half the time (Math.random() < 0.5) instead of the current tasks, so after adding a task the refetch sometimes shows an empty board and the list assertion fails intermittently. The spec and the rest of the app logic are correct; the failure is nondeterministic with no relevant code change.

expectedFailure.testTitle: creating a task shows it in the list and updates the counter
